title: Measures to Prevent Measles Outbreak in Singapore
what_it_is: Measures to Prevent Measles Outbreak in Singapore

sections.label: Measles cases in Singapore 2019
sections.summary: Singapore had 43 measles cases in the first four months of 2019, nearly three times more than the same period in 2018 due to increased global outbreaks.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Health (Mr Gan Kim Yong)
sentences.text: In the first four months of 2019, Singapore saw 43 measles cases, nearly three times more than the same period in 2018 as a result of increased global outbreaks.

sections.label: Vaccination required for foreign children
sections.summary: Foreign children applying for long-term passes must be fully vaccinated against measles.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Health (Mr Gan Kim Yong)
sentences.text: Earlier this year, we have also made it compulsory for foreign children applying for long-term passes to be fully vaccinated against measles.

sections.label: Measles vaccination coverage among children
sections.summary: Measles vaccination coverage among resident children reached 95% for the first dose at age two and 93% for the second dose at age seven.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Health (Mr Gan Kim Yong)
sentences.text: The measles vaccination coverage among resident children reached 95% for the first dose at two years of age and 93% for the second dose at seven years of age.

sections.label: Vaccination for workers caring for vulnerable
sections.summary: To protect vulnerable populations like infants and the immuno-compromised, ways will be studied to ensure workers caring for them achieve high vaccination coverage.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Health (Mr Gan Kim Yong)
sentences.text: To protect the more vulnerable populations like infants and the immuno-compromised, we will study ways to ensure that workers caring for them achieve a high level of vaccination coverage.

sections.label: Unvaccinated among reported measles cases
sections.summary: Among the 43 reported cases in the first four months of this year, 33 were not vaccinated, and up to 3% of vaccinated cases may not be effective.

sentences.speaker: Mr Gan Kim Yong
sentences.text: First, for the cases which have been reported during the first four months of this year, let me share that among the 43, 33 were not vaccinated.

sentences.speaker: Mr Gan Kim Yong
sentences.text: Even among those who were vaccinated, up to 3% may not be effective.

sections.label: Immunity levels among older adults
sections.summary: Based on studies, immunity levels among older adults are in the high 90% levels.

sentences.speaker: Mr Gan Kim Yong
sentences.text: Based on our studies, our immunity level is in the high 90% levels among the older adults.

sections.label: Vaccination of preschool children
sections.summary: The government is looking into ways to encourage and ensure preschool children are vaccinated, to protect them and unvaccinated children.

sentences.speaker: Mr Gan Kim Yong
sentences.text: Dr Chia Shi-Lu also asked about potential actions against parents whose children are not vaccinated.

sentences.speaker: Mr Gan Kim Yong
sentences.text: We are looking into various possibilities, even at the preschool level, on how we can encourage and ensure that our children who go to preschools are vaccinated because this is important not only to protect the individual children but also to protect children who could not be vaccinated.
